thread:
Aisha (PM): Quick sync for the 'Launch Currents' pilot. Goal: Dedicated SLA (p50 ~100ms, p95 ~300ms) + private on-prem pilot. Need owners, signoff dates, and fallback plan.

Matt (Eng - Runtime): Need qps and seq lengths to pick batching & KV cache policy.

Aisha (PM): Traffic: 20 qps steady, 100 qps burst. Typical seq 256 tokens, 99th ~1024.

Matt (Eng - Runtime): For 20 qps/256, p50 looks fine on A100 with batching=auto. P95 needs prewarm + KV cache. Who owns prewarm?

Sanjay (Infra): Infra can allocate a dedicated pool but we need capacity booking by EOW. Free 10-GPU slot week of May 12; after that lead time 3w. For guaranteed capacity, we need signed commitment + tenant config.

Priya (Security): Private pilot requires KMS/HSM review + threat model signoff. I need architecture and docs by May 6. Also specify where customer keys live and audit retention.

Aisha (PM): Noted — May 6 security package. Matt, can you sketch KMS flow and hosted fallback?

Matt (Eng - Runtime): Flow: 1) Request -> routing -> dedicated runtime if tenant pinned; 2) If HSM-bound -> runtime calls KMS via vault proxy for signing token; 3) If KMS down -> fallback to hosted variant (opt-in) with reduced SLA. Infra must validate VPN/VPC peering and ACLs.

Sanjay (Infra): Confirmed. Need CIDR list and egress IPs. Private customers require port 443 + mTLS. We'll provide runbook steps.

Linh (SRE): Observability needs: traces for routing -> model shard selection, per-token latency, queue depth, prefix cache hit rate, SLO dashboard. Who owns dashboard?

Aisha (PM): Product owns SLO defs. Linh + Matt to build dashboard. Template due May 8.

Linh (SRE): OK will put up Grafana template + Prometheus scrape list by May 8. Need metric names from runtime.

Matt (Eng - Runtime): Publishing metric names tomorrow. Canary plan: 5% traffic 24h -> 25% 24h -> full. Rollback if p95 >40% increase or error rate >0.5%. Agree?

Priya (Security): Add gating: no canary to private tenant until HSM signoff. Also require secrets rotation test green in staging.

Olga (Design): UX ask: show a small banner when fallback to hosted happens so support can notify customers.

Aisha (PM): Also need a degraded-performance playbook (who declares incident, who flips routing). Linh/Sanjay/Matt own runbook steps.

Sanjay (Infra): I'll draft routing flip steps (DNS/LB weight changes, BGP notes) and rollback checklist.

Matt (Eng - Runtime): For fallback model variants, propose an 8-bit quantized model as latency/cost fallback. Research eval ~2 weeks; needs quality gates. Add to rollout matrix.

Linh (SRE): Suggest chaos test: simulate KMS outage during staging canary to validate fallback. Window: May 9 02:00-04:00 UTC. Any objections?

Priya (Security): OK if keys not used and data synthetic.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: launch-currents/canary -> staging at 2026-05-09T02:15:00Z.

Aisha (PM): Owners & dates recap:
- Product (Aisha): SLO definition + rollout decision (due May 10)
- Runtime (Matt): metric names + canary plan + quant-fallback eval (metrics tomorrow, eval by May 20)
- Infra (Sanjay): capacity booking (commit by EOW), network runbook (May 6)
- Security (Priya): KMS/HSM review + signoff (May 6), secrets rotation test
- SRE (Linh): dashboards + runbook + chaos test (template May 8, chaos May 9)
- Design (Olga): fallback banner (May 7)

Aisha (PM): I'll convert to kickoff doc + action tracker. Please react with :thumbsup: to confirm.

Matt (Eng - Runtime): :thumbsup:

Sanjay (Infra): :thumbsup:

Priya (Security): :thumbsup:

Linh (SRE): :thumbsup:

Olga (Design): :thumbsup:

Aisha (PM): Thanks
